proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type = Choppy regime + UP_TRI signal (90.9%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type = Choppy regime + UP_TRI signal; recommended action: Pause new UP_TRI entries in Choppy regime until either (a) signal-type share drops below 0.85 via natural Day 6 exits or (b) Choppy×UP_TRI cohort promotes from Candidate to Tier M. Allow non-UP_TRI or non-Choppy setups to rebalance the book.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If regime shifts from Choppy to Bear with a directional break, ~90% of the book (60 UP_TRI longs) faces simultaneous stop-outs with no validated edge to justify the exposure. Bank/CapGoods/Chem cluster amplifies the drawdown via correlated sector beta.

evidence: Matched cohort Choppy×UP_TRI is Candidate tier (n=334) — unvalidated edge
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new UP_TRI entries in Choppy regime until either (a) signal-type share drops below 0.85 via natural Day 6 exits or (b) Choppy×UP_TRI cohort promotes from Candidate to Tier M. Allow non-UP_TRI or non-Choppy setups to rebalance the book.
decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If regime shifts from Choppy to Bear with a directional break, ~90% of the book (60 UP_TRI longs) faces simultaneous stop-outs with no validated edge to justify the exposure. Bank/CapGoods/Chem cluster amplifies the drawdown via correlated sector beta.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration triggered at 81.82% Choppy (above 0.80) and UP_TRI dominates signal mix at 60/66 = 90.9% (above 0.85). Matched Choppy×UP_TRI cohort sits only at Candidate tier (n=334) — unvalidated edge across all three concentrated cells (Bank 15.15%, CapGoods 12.12%, Chem 12.12%). Individual cells remain within the 0.20 tolerance, but dual regime + signal-type monoculture on an unvalidated cohort is the actionable risk.
